flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isBlownAwayLastStep - EVENT trigger (Bunker 'blown away' completes), NOT a table-state condition; will not retro-fire if missed
flipToBack.prose: Flip when the Bunker is 'blown away' (blown-away last step for a card titled Bunker). No control/occupy component at all.

children.req: timing trigger: blown-away last step of card

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if OPPONENT CONTROLS the Bunker (plain control of a location matching Filters.Bunker).

requirementSemantics: Front flip = pure TIMING TRIGGER: the Bunker blown-away event (Epic Event chain), no board-count semantics.
Back flip = OPPONENT CONTROL of the Bunker location (plain control, INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE); asymmetric with the front (event vs state).
Back Force-drain protection is a 'with <actor> there' modifier: locations same-as your scout or Ewok (Filters.sameLocationAs), not control-based.

Back Force-loss engine gated on chosen-state GameConditions.isBlownAway(game, Filters.Bunker); the draw-phase [Endor] Rebel retrieval in code is NOT gated on Bunker-blown-away despite the printed sentence attaching it to 'If bunker blown away' (Card501_094_BACK.java:81-93 has no isBlownAway check) - source divergence worth flagging for playtest text.
typedIdentities: Filters.title(Title.Bunker, true) - front flip trigger card; Filters.Bunker - back flip gate + isBlownAway checks

Filters.or(Filters.Explosive_Charge, Filters.and(Filters.icon(Icon.ENDOR), Filters.Epic_Event)) to Filters.Bunker - front deploy-phase download (GameTextActionId.REBEL_STRIKE_TEAM__DOWNLOAD_EXPLOSIVE_CHARGE_OR_ENDOR_EPIC_EVENT)
Both-sides deploy ban: Filters.and(Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.Rebel, Filters.Ewok, Filters.and(Icon.REBEL, Filters.starship))))

Both-sides activation shelter: GenerateNoForceModifier on Filters.Endor_system (code applies to any Endor system, NOT ownership-qualified despite printed 'your Endor system') with NotCondition(OnTableCondition(Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Icon.ENDOR, Filters.Objective)))
Front drain self-ban scope: Filters.and(Filters.on(Title.Endor), Filters.not(Filters.wherePresent(self, Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.icon(Icon.ENDOR), Filters.Han), Filters.Ewok))))
Back drain protection scope: Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Filters.scout, Filters.Ewok)))
Back Force-loss counters: Filters.and(Filters.Endor_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.and(Filters.icon(Icon.ENDOR), Filters.or(Filters.Han, Filters.Leia, Filters.Chewie))))

Back, once during your draw phase: retrieve an [Endor] Rebel. Card501_094_BACK.java:81-93 (code does NOT gate this on Bunker blown away)
otherObligations: Both sides: opponent activates no Force at Endor system unless their [Endor] objective on table. Card501_094.java:82-83; Card501_094_BACK.java:64-65

Back: scouts are immune to attrition < 4. Card501_094_BACK.java:70

Strategic: front's job is to blow the Bunker (deliver Explosive Charge / [Endor] Epic Event via the download); after flipping, keep opponent from controlling the Bunker or you revert.
